'''Turkeys''' were creatures. [[Mastiff phalone/Legends|Mastiff phalones]] from [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]] had turkey-like heads.<ref>{{DB|1=creature|2=mastifphalone|3=mastiff phalone}}</ref> [[Nuna/Legends|Nunas]] were also known as [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] turkeys.<ref name="The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>
